summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly financial results for Jan-Mar 2026. The filing presents consolidated operating and financial metrics, including sales revenues, net income, EBITDA, capex, and debt levels. It does not announce or relate to any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. No special situation is disclosed.
